name: hidane SDK certification matrix
description: Every client and tool hidane may be used with: the version that was run, the transport, what was exercised, a status and the recorded results behind it. Generated from results/ only. See docs/sdk-certification.md.

statuses.label: Verified
statuses.meaning: Every feature the client is expected to offer was exercised by a transcript pair whose two sides are identical or differ only as the documentation explains, and the version it ran with is known.

statuses.label: Partially verified
statuses.meaning: Some recorded results cover the client, but a feature it is expected to offer was not exercised, or the version it ran with is not known, or a difference is unexplained.

statuses.label: Not verified
statuses.meaning: No recorded result covers the client. hidane may serve its transport; nobody has compared its results yet.
